_why: Ghost Express/Node monorepo (~1010 symbols scanned). Seamcheck made 15 claims (11 unresolved fetch_target, 1 unresolved stripe_event, 3 unused env_var); all kinds were under the 12-per-kind sampling cap so all 15 were judged by reading the code. 14 are false, 1 true.

fetch:/ghost/api/admin/site/.why: Handler exists: router.get('/site', mw.publicAdminApi, ...) in ghost/core/core/server/web/api/endpoints/admin/routes.js:20, mounted via apiApp.lazyUse('/admin/', ...) under backendApp.lazyUse(BASE_API_PATH, ...) where BASE_API_PATH='/ghost/api' (core/shared/url-utils.ts:4). Multi-level lazyUse mount chain with a constant-valued prefix the tool did not follow.

fetch:/ghost/api/admin/offers.why: router.get/post('/offers', ...) at admin/routes.js:177-178, same /ghost/api -> /admin/ lazyUse mount chain.

fetch:/ghost/api/admin/invites/.why: router.post('/invites', ...) at admin/routes.js:484, same mount chain; trailing slash on the caller side also needs normalizing.

fetch:/ghost/api/admin/authentication/in.why: router.post('/authentication/invitation', ...) at admin/routes.js:440, same mount chain.

fetch:/ghost/api/admin/tiers.why: router.get('/tiers', ...) at admin/routes.js:147, same mount chain.

fetch:/ghost/api/admin/members/events/.why: router.get('/members/events', ...) at admin/routes.js:185, same mount chain; caller appends a query string and trailing slash.

fetch:/ghost/api/admin/settings/.why: router.get('/settings', ...) at admin/routes.js:110, same mount chain.

fetch:/ghost/api/admin/automated_emails/.why: router.get('/automated_emails/design', ...) at admin/routes.js:315 (and put at :324), same mount chain.
router.get('/automated_emails', ...) at admin/routes.js:314, same mount chain.

fetch:/members/api/create-stripe-checkou.why: membersApp.post('/api/create-stripe-checkout-session', ...) in ghost/core/core/server/web/members/app.js:123, mounted via frontendApp.lazyUse('/members', ...) in web/parent/frontend.js:20.

fetch:/members/api/session.why: membersApp.get('/api/session', middleware.getIdentityToken) in web/members/app.js:92, mounted at '/members' via lazyUse in web/parent/frontend.js:20.

stripe_event_unhandled:payment_intent.su.why: Ghost's webhook endpoint is created with a fixed enabled_events list (webhook-manager.js:41) that does NOT include payment_intent.succeeded, so Stripe never delivers/retries it - the note's delivery-and-retry story cannot happen. And no deferred work depends on it: payment-recorder.ts creates the PaymentIntent with confirm:true purely as a bookkeeping record and the caller (machine-payments/service.ts:264) consumes pi.id from the synchronous return value before serving the paid content.

env_var:GHOST_E2E_SKIP_BUILD.why: Declared in e2e/.env.example:7 with a comment saying it skips the docker-build pretest, but grep across ts/js/mjs/json/sh/yml/Dockerfile/md finds zero reads; the current e2e pretest script (e2e/package.json) no longer builds anything. Genuinely left over.

env_var:PRESERVE_ENV.why: Read at e2e/helpers/environment/environment-manager.ts:171 (process.env.PRESERVE_ENV === 'true') and acted on at :95 to skip teardown; also documented in e2e/README.md and docs/contributing/e2e-testing.md. Plain process.env read in a .ts helper the scan missed.

env_var:TEST_WORKERS_COUNT.why: Read at e2e/playwright.config.mjs:26 (parseInt(process.env.TEST_WORKERS_COUNT, 10)), forwarded in e2e/scripts/run-playwright-container.sh:42 (-e TEST_WORKERS_COUNT=...), and set in .github/workflows/ci.yml:2070. Reads live in a .mjs config and a shell script the env scan did not cover.
